name: pdf
description: Four PDF workflows: reports and formal documents, academic LaTeX, existing-PDF processing (merge/split/extract/watermark) and prepress QA (page renders, font embedding, overflow and missing-glyph checks).

description_i18n.en: Four PDF workflows: reports and formal documents, academic LaTeX, existing-PDF processing (merge/split/extract/watermark) and prepress QA (page renders, font embedding, overflow and missing-glyph checks).
description_i18n.zh-CN: PDF 四条产线：报告与正式文件排版、学术 LaTeX、既有 PDF 处理（合并/拆分/抽取/加水印）与印前 QA（逐页出图、字体嵌入、越界与缺字形检查）。
